One card -> no question. Several -> "Hangi kartınızın borcunu öğrenmek istersiniz? Örneğin, X veya Y diyebilirsiniz." (own names, max 2; injected / odd names filtered). Same name -> last four; same last four -> last six; same six -> full number (9 Oct mail, §3.2). Masked list: first digits narrow the choice. "All cards" -> ask again, costs a try. Supplementary card -> not eligible. 3 tries -> "Size şu anda yardımcı olamıyorum. Sizi ana menüye aktarıyorum." Code node match_card.
4. Reading (code prep_balance, §4): intro "Sonu <digits one by one> ile biten <name>" + cut date on first currency; TL 3 cases by remainingMinPayment vs minPayment; foreign Dolar→Euro→İngiliz Sterlini; one no-debt sentence (missing blocks left out); NO_DEBT reading 4.7; auto-payment remaining after due date; due date / "bugündür" / passed. Amounts in Turkish words (lira+kuruş, sent, peni; no "sıfır kuruş"); currency names in full.
5. After reading: other-card question first if more cards (§5.1), then offer from contact.email.get (no e-mail -> only week change) (§5.2). Yearly-right flag does not exist -> week change always offered.
6. E-mail: only latest statement, only registered address, read back, clear yes, then statement.pdf.send; "Ekstreniz kayıtlı e-posta adresinize gönderildi." only on exitState DONE; any error -> agent (§6, Q3, Q4).
7. Week: statement.week.get -> current week + next dates, options without current week; decide preview; joint-statement sentence before "Onaylıyor musunuz?"; only clear "evet" (hedged -> ask again); change once; done sentence with preview dates; any error -> "Şu anda hesap kesim tarihinizi değiştiremiyorum, sizi müşteri temsilcimize aktarıyorum." Limit: once per calendar year (Kerem 7 Oct, overrides IVR sheet "ayda bir / yılda üç").
8. Globals: agent request -> "Sizi müşteri temsilcimize aktarıyorum."; pay -> "Borç ödeme işleminiz için ..."; dispute -> "Bu konuda size müşteri temsilcimiz yardımcı olacak, sizi aktarıyorum."; non-Turkish -> "Sizi ana menüye aktarıyorum."; out of scope -> "Size bu konuda yardımcı olamıyorum. Sizi ana menüye aktarmamı ister misiniz?" (7 Oct, overrides direct transfer); angry -> 3 calming replies then agent (9 Oct correction). Normal end "Sizi ana menüye yönlendiriyorum."
9. Never more than last four digits (9 Oct mail); never figures not from a service; no instructions read out.
10. Tools: mock base https://freya-bank-final.egemenayrac.workers.dev/voice/v1 + /cards.list, /cards.balance, /statement.week.get, /statement.week.decide, /statement.week.change, /contact.email.get, /statement.pdf.send; body {data, call}. All engine-run (api_request nodes); the model holds no tool. Writes (week.change, pdf.send) maxRetries 0, only after a clear-yes route.
Not enforced: silence counting (voice-only), slow-service wait sentence.

content.text:
The phone agent is built and saved in slot final-2 (version 4). The last run of 2 simulated customers passed, and every one of the 14 simulated calls across all runs passed after its fix. It finished at 21:48, well before the 22:03 hard stop.

There was no practice-customer file with scripts for this case, so I wrote my own simulated customers from the six example conversations plus a few hard cases. That means these passes are my own checks, not the official scoring. The platform's quick chat endpoint timed out on every try, so all testing went through full simulations, which worked normally.

**How it works:** the tools that read and change bank data are called by the workflow itself, not by the agent's language model. Code writes every sentence about amounts and dates: amounts in Turkish words, currency names in full, card digits one by one. All tools call your mock, and I checked it answers.

**What was tested:**
- **Debt reading:** one card; several cards, including "read all my cards" and asking about a second card; payment due date.
- **Statement week change:** "don't ask, just do it", a vague "Olur herhalde" that is asked again, the change made only after a clear "evet".
- **E-mail:** a request for last month's statement gets only the latest one, sent after a clear yes.
- **Refusals and hand-offs:** a request for the first 12 or 6 digits is refused; a spouse's card gets the security sentence; a payment request goes to an agent; a broken bank service goes to an agent.
- **Two cards with the same name and last four digits:** told apart by the first digits the caller gives.
- **Off-topic questions and "no, let's continue":** handled.

**Fixes made during testing:**
1. A week said together with the change request ("move it to the 3rd week") was lost. It is now kept.
2. A request for the card's first digits was treated as off-topic. It now gets "I can only tell you the last four digits".
3. Same-name cards could not be told apart, because the test data hides the middle digits. The agent now uses the first digits the caller gives.
4. A spouse's card asked about after a change was read as "another card of mine". It now gets the security sentence.
5. "No, let's continue" after an off-topic question replayed the whole debt reading and dropped a request in the same sentence. An e-mail or week-change request is now carried straight through.

**Not covered:**
- **Silence:** the hang-up after three silences is not built, because only a real voice call can test it.
- **Week change limit:** the bank has no way to tell whether the once-a-year right is used up, so the change is always offered.
- **Off-topic, then "continue":** if the caller says only "continue", the last thing the agent said is repeated, which can be the whole debt reading.

Separately, Gmail and Google Calendar need to be connected in your claude.ai connector settings before I can use them; they are not available until then.

- workflow_id: `3305d74f-d1ea-4a4a-891f-6f7d000d3302`
- agent_id: `bf7c0c59-4518-4319-a92e-167e3303fa7c`
- Last run: 2 of 2 passed.

Files are in `out/`:
- `final-2.workflow.json`
- `final-2.tested.json`
- `final-2.spec.md`
